description: Fixed-rate, fixed-term credit markets (Morpho Midnight, not Cardano Midnight): per market the chain, loan token, maturity and days left, collateral with LLTV and oracle, credit outstanding, posted lend and borrow offers, the best lender and borrower APR and the quotes at 1k, 10k and 100k. Rates are APR (1/P − 1 over the years left), never APY, before fees, not guaranteed. Posted offers are not fillable liquidity: totals count one cap per shared budget. Also whether any Morpho vault lends into Midnight. FREE.
